source.name: Satyr
source.description:
SPECIES TRAIT: Fear 

Active when you have at least (N) different pieces on board. (Multiple effects stack.)

(2) Satyr: Allied Satyr chess pieces gain the effect: If there is more than 1 enemy nearby, they cause those enemies to lose control due to fear.
source.description_html:

Active when you have at least (N) different pieces on board. (Multiple effects stack.)

source.lore: Demonic species rose from twisted elves, experts at concealing themselves in nightmares, and fanatics in spreading blood and agony.
notes: The fear effect has an internal cooldown and cannot trigger continuously.

 Активна, когда минимум (N) разных Satyr на столе.(Эффекты складываются)
